facts.fact: 《Sieuxerr Gazette》记：应届毕业生首次穿 healer blue，从 Chancellor Jean Marcelle 手中领 generalist belts；Dux Scolaris 授给校长的亲女 Marie-Claude Marcelle，校长并宣布兴建 chorale 排练演出专用厅
facts.anchor: bestowed upon the Chancellor’s own daughter, Marie-Claude Marcelle

facts.fact: Estiene 睡过头；醒来独自在床上，Jehan 在他睡着后离开了；他口干，是白兰地的后劲
facts.anchor: He was alone in his bed. Jehan must have left after Estiene fell asleep.

facts.fact: 有人敲门，Estiene 以为/希望是 Jehan，还特意弄乱头发；开门却是父亲 Jourdain Marcelle，穿全套 feast-week Hospital 礼服、拿着黄油杏仁味的油纸袋，开口就盯住他脖子上的痕迹，讥他为毕业分数 pissing about 不睡觉
facts.anchor: I see you’ve decided to maximise your chances of a good graduation grade by pissing about

facts.fact: Estiene 回嘴：反正有你在，Chancellor 总会让我过；Jourdain 低声喝他 Keep your voice down，推门进了房间
facts.anchor: when I’ve got you around to make sure the Chancellor passes me anyway

facts.fact: Jourdain 说 Augustin Thoury 派人跟踪他，他得先绕去面包店、再对 hallmaster 演一出惊喜戏；午饭他不去监督 Grand Rounds，而要讨回最后最大的人情，好让 Estiene 即使被判有罪也留在 Sieuxerr 做体面工作
facts.anchor: now Augustin Thoury is having me tailed

facts.fact: Estiene 问 Mamie 能否帮忙，Jourdain 一口拒绝，说她不必知道；Estiene 第一次在父亲身上看到那种渴求长辈认可的痛
facts.anchor: She most certainly does not need to hear about this.

facts.fact: Jourdain 说 Estiene 拖他进这摊事，并说 I’m not the one who was found with a bloody knife standing over a corpse!；Estiene 笑，一半想收回一切，另一半（爱 Jehan 的那部分）催他 Push，随后扬言毕业后去 Fenehaf 的 Mostau 或 Resée 边镇，被父亲斥为逃跑、幼稚
facts.anchor: I’m not the one who was found with a bloody knife standing over a corpse!

facts.fact: Estiene 最后告知：考试地点改在 Teaching Theatre，不在 Rondelle，而且还会再改；父亲留下一个鄙夷的眼神后离开
facts.anchor: it’ll be at the Teaching Theatre, not the Rondelle
